notes:
Create/edit use case; saves through `set_use_cases` (upsert by id). Drawn as built; editing in the preview stays as built, also in cloud mode (decided with ADR-010).

**Dialog shell (shared by all use-case dialogs).** Native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()` — no `role`, no `aria-modal`, no manual focus trap; `aria-labelledby` the title; `autofocus` on the first field. Header: title + id chip (`chrome-chip ref`, edit mode) + close. Body scrolls, header and footer stay. A dirty form asks before it discards (Esc, close, Cancel run through a `cancel` handler / `requestClose()`). Footer: status message left (`role="status"`), Cancel, primary save.

**Fields.** Title · Group (combobox over existing group paths, free text) | ID ("fixed once used"; derived from the title in create mode) · Status (`uc-segmented two-second`: Draft / Ready — maturity of the spec, ADR-010; there is no priority field) | Tags ("comma separated") · Personas (removable chips + Add persona) · Trigger / Goal / Outcome (textareas) · Inputs and outputs (rows: In/Out, data object select, from/to, example as `key: value` list; + Input, + Output, New data object) · Steps (number, actor select incl. System, action, move up/down, remove; second line: target scope `uc-segmented` Screen / Element / None, screen select, node select listing `id · <tag> "text"`; + Data change).

**Validation = warnings, never blocking** (same rule as drift warnings): example key not a field of the object (amber field, wavy underline, line below linked via `aria-describedby`), stale target (`uc-select warning`, struck id + "This screen no longer exists. Pick another one."), unknown persona, variant op on a missing step. Footer counts them: "2 warnings. Saving is never blocked." Hard requirement only: at least one input and one output, each with an example — Save is disabled with a visible reason.

Drawing: one In row, the Mapping input of the sample omitted; steps 2, 3 and 5 collapsed. Flows: close / Cancel / Save → `usecases-detail`.
